# The measurement environment, pinned by wheel hash (#72).
#
# `pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses to install anything whose bytes are not
# one of these, and refuses to install anything not named here — so the run cannot
# silently pick up a different numpy, astropy, libqpdf or MuPDF than the one the
# numbers were recorded with. Python 3.12 on x86_64 Linux: three of the wheels are
# cp312-only. `pikepdf` carries libqpdf and `pymupdf` carries MuPDF, so no system
# PDF library is involved; `pymupdf` 2.0 pulls its layout stack (`onnxruntime` and
# friends) whether or not it is used, and those are pinned too.
